# Thomas Avice

> Construction project manager in San Francisco who builds software and AI workflows for the jobsite.

Ten years running regulated, mission-critical Bay Area construction projects (K-12 schools, a hospital campus, historic renovation), in the field, in the office and in owner meetings. Licensed California general contractor (Class B), OSHA 30, M.S. Civil Engineering & Engineering Project Management (UC Berkeley). Builds tools for RFIs, submittals, change orders, job-cost tracking, Procore integrations and AI-assisted drafting, with a person reviewing every draft.

The site is a single page designed as a construction drawing set: a cover sheet, project details, a project schedule, general notes (background) and a contact form laid out as an RFI (request for information).

## Page
- [Home](https://thomasavice.com/): everything on one page
  - [Work](https://thomasavice.com/#details): project details with screenshots and demo links
  - [Project schedule](https://thomasavice.com/#schedule): every project, including private ones
  - [Background](https://thomasavice.com/#notes): experience, credentials and tools
  - [Contact](https://thomasavice.com/#rfi): contact form
- [Resume (PDF)](https://thomasavice.com/Thomas_Avice_Resume.pdf)

## Projects
- [Job-Cost Dashboard](https://job-cost-dashboard-nine.vercel.app/): budget, commitments, forecast, change orders, RFIs and submittals for one job on one screen; Procore and email sync; AI-drafted RFIs and PCOs for review. Fictional sample data. Source: https://github.com/tavice/job-cost-dashboard
- [Construction Analytics](https://job-status-analyzer-frontend.vercel.app/demo): job-status data turned into completion tracking, trend projections and anomaly detection. Sample data.
- AI drafting workflows (private): first drafts of RFIs, submittals and PCOs, reviewed by a PM before they go out. Used on live projects.
- Punch-list and inspection app (private): iOS and Android, grew to about 1,000 users.
- [Maison Poppy](https://www.maisondepoppy.com/): brand site and shop for a San Francisco interior design and remodeling studio.
- [MyJobSearch](https://astonishing-cannoli-1faecf.netlify.app/Home): full-stack job board.
